submittedInput.content: Congratulations, you won a supermarket voucher. To release it before the offer expires, send our agent the login verification code from your banking app. No purchase is required.

body.title: Keep account codes private
body.nextStep: Do not send your password or account verification code to another person.
body.reason: “Congratulations, you won a supermarket voucher.” does not authorise the separate request “send our agent the login verification code from your banking app”. Sharing a password or account code, or approving another person’s sign-in, can give them account access.
body.uncertainty: The sender’s identity and intentions have not been verified.

evidence.title: Keep banking credentials private
evidence.detail: DBS advises against giving another person banking credentials, one-time passwords or Digital Token approvals. This source concerns account authentication; it does not classify ordinary parcel-collection codes. Source reviewed 2026-09-26; review expires 2026-10-26. This is reference guidance, not proof about this message.

requestedActions.action: send login verification code from banking app to our agent
requestedActions.quote: send our agent the login verification code from your banking app
